cds.title: University of San Francisco Common Data Set 2024-2025 (PDF, Institutional Research; latest published, fall 2024 entering class)

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs from the Common Data Set 2024-2025, section G1, which reads 'for the FULL 2025-2026 academic year' (the box saying 2025-2026 costs are not available is unticked; read on the rendered page 2026-11-03), so the year label 2025-2026 is the CDS's own: tuition $61,720, required fees $592, on-campus food and housing $18,490 (housing $12,490 + meals $6,000). Estimated expenses (G5, residents): books $1,089, transportation $1,251, other $3,195 (other shown = transportation + other). Per-credit charge $2,200 (outside 12-18 credits). USF's own cost page lists 2026-27 at tuition $63,880 and fees $612 (https://www.usfca.edu/financial-aid/undergraduate-student-costs). H6: USF offers undergraduate nonresidents institutional non-need-based aid only; 371 degree-seeking undergraduate nonresidents received institutional aid in 2024-25 (H1 ticks '2024-2025 estimated' for the aid items; average $26,650, total $9,887,088)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set 2024-2025 (fall 2024 entering class; USF has not published a 2025-26 edition). 24,888 applied, 15,358 admitted (61.7%), 920 enrolled; men + women + another gender add up to the totals. The CDS reports only a total and an in-state residency row (9,845 / 7,094 / 562 enrolled); it has no out-of-state or international applicant rows, so those are left blank. The early decision figure (85 applied, 42 admitted) covers ED only; the CDS gives no early action counts. Waitlist: 1,327 offered a place, 768 accepted, 364 admitted. SAT/ACT is optional: only 114 enrolled students (12.39%) submitted SAT scores and 24 (2.61%) ACT, so the percentile ranges cover a small, self-selected group (SAT composite 25th/50th/75th 1200/1300/1380; ACT composite 25/28/30). GPA is the average for all enrolled first-years (100% reported). Class rank was reported by 28.26%: 44% top tenth, 75% top quarter. Undergraduate enrollment (5,321) and the nonresident count (494) are the 'Total Undergraduates' column of B2 (5,287 degree-seeking).
